b: Link kholein: https://aemporio6.github.io/nexus-sourcing/
"Sign in with Google" dabayein — apni wahi Google email jo Admin ne Setup mein dali hai.
"Google hasn't verified this app" aaye to Advanced → Go to … → Continue.
Phone pe: Android ⋮ → Add to Home screen · iPhone Share → Add to Home Screen.
Upar: Home · Back · Forward · Search (Ctrl K) · Undo · Redo · Refresh · Recent (ghari) · Alerts (ghanti) · + Create.
Baayein (phone pe neeche): Home, Purchases, Shipments, Payments, Stock; More mein Products, Parties, Planner (ICC), Import, Reports, Setup.
Har order pe "👉 Next step" likha hota hai — wahi agla kaam hai, button dabayein.
Har number ke saath ⓘ How — dabane se pata chalta hai hisab kaise bana.
Har record (order, shipment, payment, product, party) ke upar "👉 Next step" — agla kaam aur us ka button.
Record khula ho to upar "‹ Prev / Next ›" (ya Alt ↑ / Alt ↓) se list ka pichla/agla record — band kiye baghair.
Filter dropdown mein "＋ Choose several…" — kai supplier / status ek saath tick karein.
Naye form mein aam values pehle se bhari hoti hain (RMB, China, pack, WAL…). Badalni hon to Setup › Lists mein "Default" chunein.
Naya order: + Create → Purchase. Supplier, lines, PI number aur PI link zaroor.
Payment: order kholein → Pay. Ek payment kai cheezon ki ho (jaise ¥22,217 mein sample, inspection) to "Split the extra" se har hissa alag likhein.
Shipment: order pe "Record shipment" → cartons, kg, forwarder, mode, UK arrival port. Pahunche to "Receive".
Receipt / invoice: record ke Docs mein link ya file lagayein. Bina receipt payment Alerts mein aati hai.
Order form mein "PI billed to" — PI kis company ke naam pe hai. Kisi aur company ke naam pe ho to Alert aata hai — supplier se Vartleaves ke naam pe reissue karwayein (import VAT ke liye).
More → Import → file chunein ya "From Google Drive" se folder/files chunein.
App khud pehchanti hai: Joyce CI, packing sheet, Shunqi PDF, Eco PI, Amazon/eBay/Temu reports.
Save se pehle total check: file total = import total ✅. Farq ho to wajah likh kar hi save hoga.
Faltu columns side panel mein: Keep / Skip. Same file dobara daali to "already in the app".
Drive mein "MY TOOL – INBOX" naam ka folder bana kar files daalein — app khud batayegi ke nayi files aayi hain.
More → Planner (ICC): product(s) chunein ya naya product likhein.
Sales/month, lead-time stages, cycle length dropdown se. Size/gift box/carton product se khud aata hai.
Result: reorder kab aur kitna, dates 🟢🟡🟠🔴, freight, 30/50/20 cash plan → "Create purchase order". Plan save / delete bhi.
Reports / Payments page pe "⬇ Payment Summary" — Excel bilkul purani Payment Summary ke style mein.
Sirf Setup › Users mein dali emails khol sakti hain; Admin "Share data" se Drive folder share karta hai. Nayi email Google Cloud › Audience › Test users mein bhi dalni hai.
Data aemporio6 ki Drive mein "MY TOOL – DATA" folder mein; roz ek backup copy khud banti hai.
Owner: menu mein ⬇ Backup aur ⬆ Load data file. Kuch delete nahi hota — Trash se wapas aa jata hai.
Kisi ko hatana ho: Setup › Users mein Active ka tick hatayein. Wahan har user ka Department bhi.
Setup › Companies mein Company number (Companies House), VAT, EORI.
More → Help / guide: yahi guide app ke andar, English aur Roman Urdu dono.
Menu mein "● Live / Saving…" dekhein. "Signed out" ho to us pe dabayein aur dobara sign in karein.
Internet na ho to kaam device pe save rehta hai, net aate hi Drive mein chala jata hai.
Screenshot le kar Admin ko bhejein.
More → Data health: 27 asool ka check (raqam, dates, links, stock, duplicate). % score, aur har masle ke saath Open / Fix button. Sangeen masle Alerts mein bhi aate hain.
Do log ek hi record ek waqt mein badlein: dono ki tabdeeli jud jati hai. Ek hi field dono ne badla ho to baad wali value rehti hai aur Alerts mein "Checked ✓" ke liye aata hai.
Do logon ne ek saath naya order banaya aur number ek hi aa gaya: ek ka number khud agla ho jata hai, us ki payment bhi saath badal jati hai.
Ghalat cheez save hi nahi hoti: ghalat date, khali/minus raqam, payment se zyada split.
Period lock (Data health): VAT quarter file hone ke baad us date tak ke records band. Owner "Unlock for this session" se khol sakta hai.
Version history (Data health): roz ki backup list → "Go back to this day". Pehle aaj ki copy khud save hoti hai.
Exchange rate roz khud online aata hai (European Central Bank). Haath se badla hua rate kabhi overwrite nahi hota.
App errors: kisi ki screen pe koi ghalti aaye to Data health mein likhi jati hai.
Open: https://aemporio6.github.io/nexus-sourcing/
Tap "Sign in with Google". Use the Google email the Admin added for you in Setup.
If Google says "this app is not verified", tap Advanced → Go to … → Continue.
On a phone: Android ⋮ → Add to Home screen · iPhone Share → Add to Home Screen.
Top bar: Home · Back · Forward · Search (Ctrl K) · Undo · Redo · Refresh · Recent (clock) · Alerts (bell) · + Create.
Left menu (bottom bar on phone): Home, Purchases, Shipments, Payments, Stock. "More" has Products, Parties, Planner (ICC), Import, Reports, Setup.
Every order shows "👉 Next step" — that is the next job. Tap its button.
Every number has ⓘ How — it explains the sum.
Every record (order, shipment, payment, product, party) shows "👉 Next step" with a button.
With a record open, use "‹ Prev / Next ›" at the top (or Alt ↑ / Alt ↓) to move through the list without closing it.
Filter dropdowns have "＋ Choose several…" — tick several suppliers / statuses at once.
New forms start with the usual values filled in (RMB, China, pack, WAL…). Change them in Setup › Lists → "Default".
New order: + Create → Purchase. Add supplier, lines, PI number and PI link.
Payment: open the order → Pay. If one payment covers several things (e.g. ¥22,217 with a sample and inspection), use "Split the extra" to record each part.
Shipment: on the order tap "Record shipment" → cartons, kg, forwarder, mode, UK arrival port. When it arrives tap "Receive".
Receipt / invoice: add the link or file under Docs. A paid payment without a receipt shows in Alerts.
The order form has "PI billed to" — the company named on the PI. If it is another company, an alert asks you to get it reissued in Vartleaves' name (needed for import VAT).
More → Import → choose files, or "From Google Drive" to pick folders/files.
The app knows: Joyce CI, packing sheets, Shunqi PDF, Eco PI, Amazon / eBay / Temu reports.
Before saving it checks totals: file total = import total ✅. If not equal you must give a reason to save.
Extra columns appear in a side panel: Keep / Skip. Importing the same file again says "already in the app".
Make a Drive folder named "MY TOOL – INBOX" and drop files there — the app tells you when new files arrive.
More → Planner (ICC): pick products or type a new product.
Set sales per month, lead-time stages and cycle length from the dropdowns. Sizes, gift box and carton come from the product.
You get: when and how much to reorder, dates 🟢🟡🟠🔴, freight, 30/50/20 cash plan → "Create purchase order". Plans can be saved and deleted.
On Reports and Payments: "⬇ Payment Summary" — an Excel file in the same style as the old Payment Summary.
Only emails listed in Setup › Users can open the app. The Admin taps "Share data" to share the Drive folder. New emails must also be added in Google Cloud › Audience › Test users.
Data lives in aemporio6's Google Drive, folder "MY TOOL – DATA". A backup copy is made every day.
Owner: ⬇ Backup and ⬆ Load data file in the menu. Nothing is deleted for ever — Trash can restore.
To remove someone: Setup › Users → untick Active. Each user also has a Department.
Setup › Companies holds the Company number (Companies House), VAT and EORI.
More → Help / guide: this guide inside the app, in Easy English and Roman Urdu.
Look at "● Live / Saving…" in the menu. If it says "Signed out", tap it and sign in again.
With no internet your work is kept on the device and saved to Drive when you are back online.
Take a screenshot and send it to the Admin.

en.h: 10. Keeping the data safe and correct
b: More → Data health: 27 rules checked (money, dates, links, stock, duplicates). A % score, and Open / Fix on every issue. Serious ones also go to Alerts.
Two people change the same record at the same time: both changes are kept. If both changed the same field, the later value stays and Alerts asks someone to tick "Checked ✓".
Two people create a new order at the same moment and get the same number: one is renumbered automatically, and its payment follows it.
Wrong data is never saved: impossible dates, empty/negative paid amounts, a split bigger than the payment.
Period lock (Data health): after a VAT quarter is filed, records up to that date are closed. The owner can "Unlock for this session".
Version history (Data health): the daily backups → "Go back to this day". A copy of today is saved first.
Exchange rates come in by themselves every day (European Central Bank). A rate typed by hand is never overwritten.
App errors: any error on anyone's screen is written down in Data health.
